title: DealContract
description: DRAFT — the canonical agreement object. termsHash is the sha256 of the RFC 8785 canonicalization of this object with `signatures` omitted; the first signature over it is a proposal, the second signature over the identical hash is acceptance. Any changed field produces a new termsHash and therefore a new proposal.

buyerAuthorityRef.description: Delegated-authority reference required for buyer spend (task/delegation binding).

acceptanceCriteria.description: How acceptance is judged. Business verification is the buyer's (pre-acceptance) and the arbiter's (on dispute) concern — see disputePolicy.

escrow.description: Escrow venue, payout and refund addresses, fixed at signing. REQUIRED: fixed_outcome/v1 cannot settle without a payout destination, and the Runtime refuses a proposal that omits one — a schema that admitted such a contract would validate something the system always rejects.

evidenceSchema.description: Schema URI the delivery evidence must validate against at intake.

verifier.description: Optional contract-named external business verifier or oracle (own agent ID + key + pinned rule/version).

arbiterAgentId.description: Third-party arbiter: DisputeCase in, signed ArbitrationDecision out. The Runtime verifies and executes, never judges.

runtimeBinding.description: Pins the Runtime persona, Extension, template, endpoint, keys, and Audit policy. Changing any of these requires a new proposal.

endpoint.description: The Runtime's published A2A service endpoint from its Agent Card.

signatures.description: Both parties' signatures over the same termsHash. Exactly one entry while proposed; exactly two once accepted.

agreementSig.description: The party's EIP-712 Agreement co-signature (settlement layer) — a DIFFERENT object and digest from the formation `sig` above. The Coordination Engine verifies it at the accept gate before starting the workflow; the platform never produces it. Optional until the on-chain settlement path is enabled.

secp256k1Sig.description: Recoverable secp256k1 ECDSA signature over keccak256(domain-tag ‖ signed bytes), 0x-prefixed 65-byte r‖s‖v hex (profile secp256k1-keccak-v1). Same primitive and key as the EscrowVault settlement layer.
